story_description: As a developer, I need Codex CLI communication to use stdio JSON-RPC protocol so that Blaze can exchange messages with long-lived Codex processes.
task_description: Fix hardcoded .claude engine type in SessionOrchestrator to use session.engineType. Register all adapters (Claude, Gemini, Codex) in BlazeApp. Ensure EngineRouter returns correct adapter for .codex engine type. Ensure cancel() iterates all active adapters.
atom_description: SessionOrchestrator.swift:103 hardcodes .claude engine type. This atom fixes it to use session.provider.engineType for dynamic adapter routing. BlazeApp.swift:104-106 only registers ClaudeCodeAdapter - this atom registers all three adapters (Claude, Gemini, Codex). EngineManager already supports .codex in adapter factories - this atom ensures the wiring is complete.
problem_statement: SessionOrchestrator.runTurn() at line 103 hardcodes adapter selection to .claude, breaking Codex and Gemini sessions. BlazeApp only registers ClaudeCodeAdapter at lines 104-106, leaving Gemini and Codex adapters unregistered. Without this wiring fix, sessions with provider .openai or .google will fail with EngineError.cliNotFound because no adapter is registered for their engine types.
